articles.summary: Adient recently participated in the 22nd J.P. Morgan Global China Summit in Shanghai. James Huang, executive vice president, APAC, and Linda Conrad, vice president of FP&A and investor relations, together with the Adient China management team, met with investors and J.P. Morgan auto research team. During the meeting, James Huang shared Adient China’s business highlights...
articles.title: Adient Attends 2026 J.P. Morgan Global China Summit
